# Config: meta

> **Reader:** none
> **Schema:** `config/json/config.schema.json` → `properties.meta` · scope personal

What a saved or exported config is: its title, description and source (where it came from). A live config.json has none.

Each setting: `path` · type = default · enum/range/unit; then title: description; annotations; `read:` the reader member(s) (exact unless marked) and `in:` the files that use them.
